question: In which of the following sports, apart from volleyball, do players make use of the Screen technique?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Basketball.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Screen technique** is used in **basketball **apart from volleyball.
 
• In basketball, players use the Screen technique to **block the path of an opposing player, **allowing their teammate to move past them.
 
• Basketball is a team sport where players score points by shooting a ball through a hoop elevated 10 feet above the ground.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Volleyball** is a team sport where players use their hands, arms, or any other part of their body to **hit the ball over a net **and into the opponent's court.
 
• **Cricket** is a bat-and-ball game played between two teams of **11 players each.**
 
 
• **​**While the bowling and fielding side tries to **stop this** and dismiss every batter, the batting side scores runs by** hitting the ball **bowled at one of the wickets with the bat and then **sprinting** between the wickets.
 
 
 
• **Baseball** is a bat-and-ball game played between two teams of **nine players each.**
 
 
• **​**There are **nine innings** in the game, each with **two halves.**
 
• One team's players bat first and try to score runs in the **top half of the inning**, while the other team plays in the field and tries to prevent the **offensive team** from scoring.
 
 
 
• **Handball **is a team sport where players **pass a ball using their hands **with the aim of scoring goals in a net.
 
 
• **Two 30-minute periods** make up a typical game, and the team with the** most goals wins.**
